study type: Prospective longitudinal survey, embedded within a cluster randomized trial
exposure: Women with a spontaneous vaginal birth
Women with an emergency repeat cesarean
cohort: 880 women with a history of one previous cesarean in three European countries
finding: Women with a history of one previous cesarean who had a spontaneous vaginal birth had higher HRQoL scores at 3 months postpartum compared to those who had an emergency repeat cesarean.
mod_finding: Women with a spontaneous vaginal birth had significantly higher HRQoL scores on the vitality dimension compared with women with an emergency repeat cesarean.
